follow-up time: Until onset of labor or 42+0 weeks gestation
outcome: Probability of spontaneous onset of labor (SOL)
cohort: 15,253 women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies in cephalic presentation between 41+0 and 42+0 weeks' gestation
finding: While younger maternal age, higher parity, lower BMI, and lower weight gain were statistically associated with a higher likelihood of spontaneous labor, these factors were not strong predictors of spontaneous labor in women with uncomplicated pregnancies at 41+0 weeks gestation.
